verdict.rationale: Sumsub offers only adjacent controls. Sandbox mode lets you test integrations and webhooks before going live, and customizations can be previewed. Webhook rollout percentage allows staged traffic shifts (10% → 50% → 100%), which could also be dialed back. Nothing shows versioning, diff-style review, or one-click rollback of automations such as verification levels or monitoring rules. Missing for 10: versioning of levels/workflows/rules, change history and review/approval, explicit rollback to prior configurations, and independent corroboration.
